stories.title: Sixth grader in Texas foster care says art and humor help him cope while waiting for a family
stories.summary: Jackson is a bright 11-year-old boy who enjoys getting his creative energy flowing. He also loves making people laugh.

stories.title: Forecast: Thanksgiving brings a frosty start to Central Texas as holiday travel continues across the country
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: Pearland HS band raises $350,000 to stay in NYC for rescheduled Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: More than 500 band and color guard students will stay for Saturday’s parade after supporters met the goal to cover unexpected travel costs.

stories.title: Man arrested following suspected road rage shooting at Georgetown shopping center
stories.summary: Mark Rodriguez, 26, faces a charge of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon.

stories.title: City of Austin opening cold weather shelters Wednesday night
stories.summary: People seeking shelter can register from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. Wednesday at One Texas Center, 505 Barton Springs Road, the main check-in site.

stories.title: ‘She’s not coming back’ | Mothers seek answers after best friends, 15 and 16, die in Aldine
stories.summary: The girls’ mothers are seeking answers about their final hours. A man faces an evading arrest charge but has not been charged in either death.

stories.title: San Marcos warns residents after dog tests positive for rabies near city limits
stories.summary: The dog tested positive for the virus after being found Nov. 19 in the 2700 block of Center Point Road.

stories.title: Austin explores rental assistance program as South Congress businesses face rising costs
stories.summary: Noah Marion's South Congress store is set to close Dec. 31. He said the business will move its retail operations back to South Lamar, where it first began.

stories.title: Convicted Fort Hood shooter files motion for stay of execution
stories.summary: The man convicted in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting has filed a motion for a stay of execution to halt his scheduled death by firing squad.

stories.title: As screwworm cases surge, researchers say they've found new, safer technology to combat the pest
stories.summary: Texas A&M AgriLife researchers say they have successfully sterilized New World screwworm flies without using radioactive material.

stories.title: Texas State's ALERRT Center receives $10M to expand active shooter response training
stories.summary: The money will fund the fiscal 2026-27 Preparing for Active Shooter Situations program.

stories.title: Gillespie County sheriff investigates vandalism at Stonewall Catholic church
stories.summary: Investigators believe someone threw a rock at the stained glass, causing the damage. A derogatory note was also found on church property.
